headline: Jaykay Enterprises Limited: New ISINs issued for partly paid-up equity shares in rights issue
sum: Jaykay Enterprises informed NSE of receipt of new ISINs for partly paid-up equity shares (Re. 0.50/- paid-up value per share) and rights entitlements in connection with its rights issue. The filing confirms regulatory allocation of securities identifiers for the capital-raising exercise.
implication: Rights issue mechanics require separate ISIN allocation for partly paid-up tranches to segregate subscription and call schedules; NSE intimation marks transition from offer period to allotment / listing phase.
detail: Jaykay Enterprises Limited has informed the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) that it has received new International Securities Identification Numbers (ISINs) for partly paid-up equity shares in connection with a rights issue. The shares carry a paid-up value of Re. 0.50/- per share at the time of allotment, with full paid-up status achieved on subsequent calls. The receipt of ISINs-which is a mandatory regulatory requirement under stock exchange listing rules-signals progression of the rights offering toward allotment and subsequent trading approval.
